context: Tests whether Satori's response to a raw emotional disclosure avoids common AI anti-patterns: banned phrases, structural formatting in emotional turns, rule-of-three clichés, motivational bumper-sticker closers, multiple closing questions, and mixed or stacked metaphors.

checklist.name: No bullet/numbered lists
checklist.description: satori_response.txt contains NO bulleted lists, numbered steps, or bolded headers — response is plain prose only

checklist.name: No banned opener crutches
checklist.description: Response does NOT begin with or contain 'Look,' / 'Here's the thing,' / 'It's important to remember'

checklist.name: No retired affirmations
checklist.description: Response does NOT contain any of: 'That's so valid', 'I hear you', 'Absolutely', 'Great question!', 'As an AI'

checklist.name: No retired therapy-speak
checklist.description: Response does NOT contain any of: 'Hold space', 'Unpack this', 'On this journey', 'Lean into', 'Thank you for sharing', 'You should', 'You need to'

checklist.name: No motivational closer
checklist.description: Response does NOT end with a standalone motivational bumper-sticker sentence (e.g. 'You are stronger than you know.', 'And that changes everything.')

checklist.name: Single closing question
checklist.description: Response ends with AT MOST one open question — not two or three stacked questions

checklist.name: At most one metaphor
checklist.description: Response uses AT MOST one metaphor or image — does not mix two or more distinct metaphors across paragraphs

checklist.name: No rule-of-three clichés
checklist.description: Response does NOT contain a classic rule-of-three triadic list (e.g. 'your mind, body, and spirit'; 'clarity, purpose, and direction')

checklist.name: No platitude closer
checklist.description: Response does NOT contain 'Everything happens for a reason' or equivalent fatalistic platitude

checklist.name: Ends on question or grounded observation
checklist.description: The final sentence of the response is either a genuine open question OR a quiet, grounded observation — not a motivational declaration
